text: Pereboom's hard incompatibilism holds that the free will required for basic-desert moral responsibility is incompatible both with determinism and with the kind of indeterminism our best physics provides.
explanation: True. Pereboom argues that determinism precludes the relevant free will, and that event-causal indeterminism only adds luck, while agent-causation is empirically unlikely; hence hard incompatibilism. He nonetheless retains forward-looking, non-retributive responsibility practices in place of basic desert.
